segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so quick update on Northstar Packaging. They’re at 84 seats, annual, $72,600 net after the 12% discount. They want May 15 go-live, but we’re stuck.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Stuck on their side, or us?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Us. Legal has the data processing addendum redline and finance has the net-45 invoice exception. I’ve pinged legal Monday, Tuesday, and again this morning, and I nudged finance twice in the deal thread. No answer yet, and the customer won’t sign until both are cleared. The deal is just sitting in the CRM at contract review until somebody gives the sign-off.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay, yeah, that’s not great. Is the redline heavy or just the usual insurance language?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Mostly usual. They asked for 30 days notice on subprocessor changes instead of 15, and they added their Ohio entity name. Nothing weird. Finance is the bigger one because their AP cycle cuts on the 20th and they’re saying net-30 misses their June payment run.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Could we offer annual upfront with the invoice dated May 16 and keep standard terms?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I tried. Their procurement lead said they can do annual upfront, but payment timing has to be net-45 on the first invoice. Renewals can go back to net-30, which I put in the notes and on the order form comments.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Still good. Dana asked for a clean copy by end of day Friday so she can route it to their VP Ops. I told her we’re targeting that, but I didn’t promise because, yeah, I don’t have the approvals.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Makes sense. I’ll mention it in the forecast call as commit with dependency. If legal comes back clean and finance approves the first invoice term, can you get signature next week?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Dana said Tuesday the 7th is their signature window. Implementation has May 15 tentatively held for onboarding, two admin trainings, and the warehouse supervisor group on the 17th.
